name: LKS Product Connector
author: Linkstyles

sections.description:
Our product library plugin is the ideal choice for building your perfect online store. Whether you’re a personal blogger or a small e-commerce website, our plugin can help you showcase and manage products. With our product library plugin, you can easily upload, edit, and display various product information, providing clear product display pages for your visitors. Our plugin is designed to be simple and user-friendly, allowing you to focus on showcasing the various details of your products and attracting more customers. Start using our product library plugin now to add more appeal to your website!

Short Description

Our product library plugin is the ideal choice for building your perfect online store.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License along with this plugin. If not, see https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/lks-product-connector/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the source code?

The source code for this plugin is located in the /source-code/ directory, which contains unminified versions of JavaScript and CSS files for code review.
